name: Qulture.Rocks
long_description:
Qulture.Rocks makes people management, OKR management, and culture management software for some of the world's most innovative companies, backed by the likes of Founders Fund, Blackstone, Sequoia, and Tiger Global.

Our suite of products encompasses 1:1s, engagement surveys, performance reviews, OKRs/goals, ongoing feedback, and peer to peer recognition, and integrates seamlessly with your existing software (including Slack).

We also help our customers design their processes, which is of special help for startups and scaleups implementing these practices for the first time.
one_liner: The people, management, and culture operating system for your startup.

name: Spokn
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description:
Spokn makes it easy for People and Comms teams to make videos starring their own employees and leaders - no editing skills or special equipment necessary.  In minutes, you can create videos that feel as engaging as TikTok, and share them anywhere: Slack/Teams, your LMS, intranet, careers page, or job offer emails.  

Companies like InterContinental Hotels, Coinbase, Twilio, Opendoor, Udemy, SiriusXM, Gong and more use Spokn to create engaging videos for their learning & development, internal comms, recognition, DEI and employer branding.
one_liner: AI-powered video platform for Internal Comms and HR teams

name: Ossus
long_description:
We build intelligence for cultural institutions.

Our first commercial product is for the literature industry with a focus on school and public libraries. It is a AI-native OS for libraries, that helps librarians save time on tedious tasks and lets them focus on their patrons.

launches.title: Librar Labs: The AI librarian
launches.tagline: AI library system that increases reading and saves time for library staff
launches.body:
The reading rates have hit an all time low. That’s why Librar Labs built the AI library system that helps library staff save time and increase the library’s impact.\
\
AI is able to navigate the digital world of literature in ways never seen before. This powerful technology is used to increase the output of the hundreds of schools using Librar, and is being adopted at a pace never seen before in publishing, library and archive tech history.\
\
The team of quantum physicists, exited founders and dropouts are backed by founders and operators from OpenAI, Depict, Kahoot, Google Maps and many more to tackle the one of the greatest problems of our time.\
\

launches.title: Librar Labs - AI for librarians
launches.tagline: Librar takes care of the tedious work, so librarians can focus on building reading culture and community
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97314&key=user_uploads/1669339/2518baf4-5e9f-4fc4-af61-4cb76bd44e7d)

Announcing Librar Labs - AI for librarians

Librarians spend countless hours on tedious work that they don’t like, but still have to do. Today, Librar is used in nearly 300 schools, helping librarians cut down on inventory, reporting, and acquisitions work so they can do what they are best at and enjoy the most: engaging with the community.

One of the most liked features is how the librarian with a photo of the shelf, Librar identify the items and can take inventory, analyze circulation or even just set up the library.

One of the Librar founders used to work as a librarian and saw the day-to-day challenges firsthand. Since managing a library is very challenging, we decided to build Librar to make it easier for everyone.\
\
If you are (or know) any librarians or principals reach out to us on [linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonathangortz) or mail: [jonathan@librarlabs.com](mailto:jonathan@librarlabs.com)\
\
Go to our website to find out about all the things Librar can do:\
<https://www.librarlabs.com/>
